verdict.rationale: Brex's product pages document multi-level approval flows routed automatically by amount, vendor, and employee role for bill pay, and expense policies that define who must approve. That covers the core multi-step chain. However, the only escalation evidence is an AI review agent that escalates policy exceptions, not one that escalates when approvers sit on requests, and delegation is never mentioned. Missing for 10: approver delegation/out-of-office reassignment, time-based escalation of stalled approvals, explicit manager→budget owner→finance chain configuration for expenses, detailed first-party docs or independent corroboration beyond marketing copy.
